originalEntry.description: A 60-second music video in the spirit of Peter Gabriel's Sledgehammer and Big Time, with modern references and a new song written to fit the album So.

originalEntry.prompt: Create a 60 second music video in the style of Peter Gabriel's Sledgehammer and Big Time. But use modern references and figures. Also create the song, something sounds like it would fit on Peter Gabriel's So album.
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 做一支 60 秒的音乐 MV，风格参照 Peter Gabriel 的《Sledgehammer》和《Big Time》，但要用现代的文化元素和人物。歌也一起做，听起来要像能收进 Peter Gabriel《So》专辑的曲子。
